ownerRequest: Build the requirement-to-verification capability on the verified reusable application foundation, including full real-task and second-domain proof, shared interfaces, unfamiliar-agent inspection and preservation.

acceptance.expected: Pinned project-model bindings define requirement, method, case and execution vocabulary against the governing schema; edits, deletion and incompatible schema changes cannot silently reinterpret existing verification.

Cases retain an exact requirement basis, stable criterion IDs, validated native acceptance text ranges/quotes, complete or explicitly partial source coverage and exact criterion-to-method assignments; missing or duplicate obligations cannot become verified.

Controlled executions atomically preserve activity identity, exact method/requirement/design/supporting input states, conditions, actual observations and typed per-criterion passed/failed/blocked/not_run results with immutable receipts; prose outcomes and report links alone are insufficient.

Guarded result selection accounts for selected and competing executions, requires rationale for supersession, rejects unrelated scope and prevents a later unassessed failure or partial run from being silently bypassed in favor of an older passing result.

Analysis separates planning coverage, execution outcome, evidence drift/unknowns, assessed applicability and effective scoped verification. Full verification requires every declared obligation passed/applicable, complete source coverage and a controlled immutable conclusion; authored status alone cannot establish it.

Relevant requirement/method/design/support changes preserve historical execution/conclusions and require explicit reassessment or basis revision. Unrelated annotations do not retire applicability; unknown material and stale comparison/proposal guards cannot establish current verification.

Core, typed HTTP/client and CLI share guarded atomic operations, original-intent success recovery, stable identities and bounded complete reads, including invalid, partial, stale, interrupted, superseded and reopened/reassessed cases in two materially different configured domains.

A real currently unverified Tracer requirement retains unchanged acceptance and a declared method, genuine failing execution, justified correction, passing verification and later relevant-change reassessment. Original failures/candidates remain inspectable; failures are not manufactured to satisfy this lifecycle.

The shared workspace authors verification bases/executions/selections and explains results/outstanding work through shared services, retains drafts and uncertain-save recovery, and undergoes an independent fresh-agent task with material findings addressed and human validation explicitly separate.

Existing identity/history/evidence/outcomes and interface/storage compatibility are preserved, deliberate migrations are rehearsed if needed, deterministic export/SQLite backup recovery is verified, owning docs/register retain exact candidate evidence and uncertainties, and appropriate regression/architecture/quality gates pass unchanged.

gapAnalysis.existing: Ordinary native identities, fields, relationships, immutable revisions and exact pins
gapAnalysis.reuse: Represent cases, plans and executions with ordinary configured native types. Criteria are subordinate IDs within the case basis.
gapAnalysis.missing: Capability-specific descriptor validation and controlled ownership; no additional structural primitive is justified.

gapAnalysis.existing: Atomic evaluation composition and durable original-intent outcome recovery
gapAnalysis.reuse: One native/receipt/outcome transaction, guards and existing recovery namespace.
gapAnalysis.missing: Executor operation discriminator currently imports AssessmentOperation from one capability. Widen the application-owned operation contract without changing existing intent bytes or introducing a dispatch framework.

gapAnalysis.existing: Receipt inputs capture native/content/direct relationships, outcome is free text
gapAnalysis.reuse: Exact versions, observations and provenance, selected facets and historical state.
gapAnalysis.missing: Typed per-criterion execution semantics and validated correlation to the governing case/method. A free-text PASS is not machine-authoritative verification.

gapAnalysis.existing: Comparison/review retain drift, unknowns, supersession and explicit applicability separately
gapAnalysis.reuse: Existing declared-input comparison and applicability tokens; no second review ledger.
gapAnalysis.missing: Criterion/method basis invariants, controlled adoption of reviewed execution applicability, complete result accounting and derived scoped verification.

gapAnalysis.existing: Native project requirement/verification_plan conventions and structural coverage
gapAnalysis.reuse: Existing plan identities/method/expectedResult and links; coverage remains structural.
gapAnalysis.missing: Prose criterionScope and authored executionStatus/verificationStatus do not prove criterion results. No implicit conversion of legacy results/status on open.

gapAnalysis.existing: Shared workspace task drafts and mutation recovery
gapAnalysis.reuse: Shared shell/client/recovery, service-derived states and accessible bounded choices.
gapAnalysis.missing: Verification authoring/result inspection and criterion-level explanations using the new services.

criteria.identity: Stable local ID per case basis; no criterion record required.
criteria.source: Explicit named native acceptance field with exact start/end offsets and quote, validated against pinned requirement text.
criteria.complete: Disjoint ranges account for every non-whitespace character of every selected acceptance field; complete-source declaration and rationale remain visible. This does not prove adequacy of the requirement.
criteria.partial: Explicit partial scope never yields whole-scope verified.
criteria.revision: Stable IDs retain explicit old/new mapping through deliberate basis revision; no automatic prose parser or silent reanchoring.

contracts.plans: One or more pinned native methods per case, explicit criterion/method assignments; all assigned methods are required in the initial profile. Expected-result and method source fields are captured.
contracts.executions: An ordinary native activity with immutable controlling receipt: case/basis/method identity, conditions, exact input selections and each assigned criterion result. Missing results are explicit not_run or rejection, never assumed pass. Execution observations are attestations of work performed by a person/tool; Tracer does not run arbitrary user-supplied commands.
contracts.selection: Recording does not auto-select a favorable result. Explicit guarded selections name evidence for every obligation and account for other controlled executions with rationale; newly recorded execution evidence requires reconciliation. Supersession stays within declared case/method/criterion scope and preserves originals.
contracts.conclusion: Controlled immutable certificate over complete scope and accounted selected execution/applicability facts. Native authored state/JSON cannot forge it. The selected case is the unit of scoped verification; multiple requirement cases are displayed rather than silently merged.
contracts.reassessment: Relevant drift retires effective applicability without rewriting history. Changed criteria/method require deliberate basis revision and new execution for affected obligations. Changed design/support may use an explicit applicable review only while criteria/method still match and unknowns are absent. Reopen preserves the prior certificate.
contracts.legacy: Existing requirement/plan status strings and raw receipts remain annotations/supporting evidence. No automatic typed-result promotion, automatic schema upgrade or bulk rewrite.
contracts.configuration: Bounded versioned descriptor binds requirement, plan, case, execution types/fields, relationship permissions and supported result vocabulary. Fixed semantics remain service-owned, no expression/rules engine.
operations: revise basis with explicit criterion mapping
locate/list requirement cases with bounded completeness
contracts.recovery: Reuse original-intent evaluation command/outcome protocol. Exact repeats return original success before current guards; changed intent conflicts, rejection reserves no successful ID, unknown responses lock writes until explicit reconciliation; no implicit retry.

bounds.capture: Existing tighter receipt/relationship/metadata/input limits also apply. Complete-population overflow refuses completion; paged history does not imply full accounting.

realCase.status: candidate requiring formal failing execution before confirmed proof selection
realCase.candidateFinding: Next-work rows count entity input comparisons but omit direct relationship-input comparisons even though those comparisons qualify the changed/unknown evidence state. A direct-relationship-only change can therefore display zero changed/unknown inputs in a nonempty changed-evidence queue.

readOnlyProjectProbe.interpretation: No already-stale direct relationship was found in the current development database. This does not establish correct behavior after a directly captured relationship changes. No project material was changed to fabricate a failure.

realCase.method: Declare the exact regression and existing AC-1/AC-2 queue checks before the formal run. Use a disposable project and real Tracer implementation to exercise a normal directly captured relationship edit/removal, retaining the original output outcome and exact candidate/procedure hashes. Only a genuine failed assertion selects this as the real requirement proof. Complete all unchanged AC-1/AC-2 checks before promoting requirement verification; the focused regression alone is partial evidence.
realCase.executionScope: Synthetic engineering fixture data testing an actual product obligation and production code; not physical engineering verification or user validation.

proofObligations: Audit and preserve all ten unchanged criteria and the full active goal.
Execute two differently configured vocabularies through real core/HTTP/CLI, including negative/recovery and complete lifecycle cases.

Carry the selected real requirement through genuine failure, justified correction, complete passing evidence and later reassessment using the new capability; early characterization evidence alone does not finish it.
Shared UI verification and independent fresh-agent task; retain first attempt, assistance, findings and corrections separately from representative-human validation.
Exact source/procedure/report manifests, immutable observations/receipts, command recovery, prior-data preservation, export/backup parity and final unchanged quality gates.
notClaimed: Automatic engineering truth or release approval
implementationQuestions: Concrete wire/type names and response unions must be settled against the bounded specification before implementation.
Validate available repository queries against per-case execution discovery; add an indexed port only if measurements demonstrate a missing bounded read.
Measure source/range and result metadata against existing receipt capture bounds before finalizing request sub-budgets.
